title: Dana RS Stats reload data not working
symptom: In version 3.2, the option to reload data from pump DANA RS to get TDD data to display does not work. Hitting the reload connects with pump but no data is shown in the Stats screen.
cause: After a fresh install, older records from the pump are ignored, so no data appears until new data accumulates.
fix: Wait a few days for new data to accumulate; stats are then generated for the last two days.
evidence_quote: then older records from pump are ignored .... wait a few days
